pois.label: 动力段（7×YF-100K）
pois.detail: 尾段防热裙内并联 7 台 YF-100K 补燃循环发动机：中心 1 台 + 环布 6 台，钟形喷管，外圈 6 台各配双作动器燃气摇摆机构负责推力矢量。回收着陆时仅点中心机深节流。地面参数按 YF-100 系公开数据推定；火星部署构型换装 ISRU 甲烷改型（见五米级芯卡）。
sim: L2 升轨（scripts/sim_ascent_veh_rocket_02.py）：火星 RTLS 构型只点 3/7 台 @70%（2.81 MN，起飞 T/W=2.53；7 台全点会到 8.4）——峰值加速度 7.6 g_mars，max-Q 仅 0.62 kPa
L2 返场（sim_boostback）：boostback 用 2 台、着陆用中心 1 台；过冲推力比的硬约束——箭体越烧越轻，着陆剖面 a_ref 必须钉在「末端质量×(g+a_ref)/F ≥ 40% 深节流下限」上（返场取 8 m/s²），否则油门钳位过度减速、空中跑飞；制导附中途关机-再点火保护
着陆末段无法悬停（min 节流 T/W≈1.5）→ 挂点上方 0.5 m 关机跌落挂缆，兼顾不烧网
pois.detail_en: Seven YF-100K staged-combustion engines cluster inside the aft heat-shield skirt: 1 center + 6 in a ring, bell nozzles, the outer six gimbaled by twin-actuator hot-gas TVC. Recovery landing lights only the deep-throttled center engine. Ground figures follow public YF-100-family data; the Mars-deployed build swaps to the ISRU methane variant (see the 5-meter core card).
sim_en: L2 ascent (scripts/sim_ascent_veh_rocket_02.py): the Mars RTLS build lights only 3 of 7 at 70% (2.81 MN, liftoff T/W = 2.53; all seven would hit 8.4) - peak accel 7.6 g_mars, max-Q a mere 0.62 kPa

L2 return (sim_boostback): boostback on 2 engines, landing on the center one; the overthrust hard constraint - the booster burns ever lighter, so the landing profile a_ref must be pinned by "terminal mass x (g + a_ref) / F >= the 40% throttle floor" (8 m/s2 for the return), else the throttle clamps, over-decelerates and the booster balloons off profile; guidance carries a mid-burn cutoff-and-relight guard
No hover at the end (min-throttle T/W ~ 1.5) -> cut thrust 0.5 m above the catch point and drop onto the cables, which also keeps the net out of the plume

pois.label: 栅格舵（4 片，折叠贴壁）
pois.detail: 一级顶部正交布置 4 片栅格舵，钛合金格栅结构（粗肋示意），待发状态折叠贴壁，再入时展开约 100° 提供气动控制力。环视时可用「▶ 栅格舵展开/收拢」动作演示收放。
sim: L1.5 舵效包线（scripts/sim_gridfin_veh_rocket_02.py）：姿控需求力矩 0.56 MN·m 对应达标动压 3.8 kPa——地表要 618 m/s、20 km 高空要 1522 m/s；跳跃演示全程舵效仅 3%，RTLS 返场再入峰值也只有 19% → 火星构型栅格舵的主要职能是网捕挂钩，姿控靠推力矢量+RCS
L2 挂缆缓冲（sim_catch）：RTLS 到网质量 51.4 t、4.1 m/s 挂网——恒力缓冲绞车 n=2 方案单钩峰值 95 kN、行程 2.27 m，对 250 kN 设计载荷裕度 2.6×、对 6 m 行程裕量 2.6×（弹性缆方案动载系数 3.3，劣于恒力方案）
pois.detail_en: Four titanium grid fins in orthogonal positions at the top of the stage (coarse lattice shown), folded flat when stacked and deploying ~100 deg for entry aero control. The inspect view offers a "grid fins deploy/stow" action.
sim_en: L1.5 fin-authority envelope (scripts/sim_gridfin_veh_rocket_02.py): the 0.56 MN m control-moment requirement maps to 3.8 kPa of dynamic pressure - 618 m/s at the surface, 1522 m/s at 20 km; the hop demo never exceeds 3% authority and even RTLS entry peaks at 19% -> on Mars the grid fins mainly serve as catch hooks, attitude falls to TVC + RCS

L2 cable-catch damping (sim_catch): RTLS arrives at the net at 51.4 t and 4.1 m/s - the constant-force winch scheme (n=2) peaks at 95 kN per hook over a 2.27 m stroke, 2.6x margin on the 250 kN design load and 2.6x on the 6 m stroke (an elastic-cable scheme has a 3.3 dynamic load factor, worse than constant-force)

pois.label: 着陆腿（4 条，收拢贴壁）
pois.detail: 尾段对角方位 4 条着陆腿（与栅格舵方位错开 45°），主撑 + 副撑 + 大脚垫，待发状态收拢贴壁，末端着陆前液压展开锁定。铰点处有收放整流罩。环视时可用「▶ 着陆腿展开/收拢」动作演示。

specs.构型: 主撑 + 副撑 + 脚垫

sim: L1 手算：空箭回收态 CG 低（~12 m 级），4 腿展开跨距 ~13 m → 静态倾覆坡度极限 >25°，比满载飞船着陆（veh-rocket-01 绑定工况）宽松得多
pois.detail_en: Four landing legs on the diagonal azimuths (offset 45 deg from the grid fins), main strut + brace + wide pad, stowed flat when stacked and hydraulically deployed and locked before terminal landing. Hinge points are faired. The inspect view offers a "landing legs deploy/stow" action.
sim_en: L1 hand check: the empty recovery booster has a low CG (~12 m class) and a ~13 m deployed footprint -> static tip-over slope limit > 25 deg, far more relaxed than the laden-ship landing (the veh-rocket-01 binding case)

pois.label: 飞船段 + 逃逸塔
pois.detail: 顶部为 Ø5.2 m 肩部整流裙 + 梦舟风格载人飞船（服务舱 + 钝锥返回舱）+ 逃逸塔。逃逸塔顶端细塔杆挂逃逸主发动机（4 斜置喷管）与 4 片格栅稳定翼——上升段应急时拽着返回舱脱离箭体。返回舱 +Z 侧双舷窗夜间发光。

specs.飞船: 梦舟风格（服务舱+返回舱）
specs.逃逸塔: 塔杆 + 4 斜喷管 + 4 格栅稳定翼

sim: L1 手算：逃逸要求 ~10 g 级加速度把飞船在 2 s 内拉开 >100 m；火星大气稀薄无 max-Q 高压段，逃逸窗口工况比地球温和
pois.detail_en: Up top: a 5.2 m shoulder fairing skirt, a Mengzhou-style crew spacecraft (service module + blunt-cone reentry capsule) and the escape tower. The tower mast carries the escape main engine (4 canted nozzles) and 4 lattice stabilizer fins - in an ascent abort it drags the capsule clear of the stack. The capsule +Z twin portholes glow at night.
sim_en: L1 hand check: an abort demands ~10 g-class acceleration to pull the capsule >100 m clear in 2 s; the thin Martian atmosphere has no high-Q phase, so abort cases are milder than on Earth

pois.label: 五米级芯（ISRU 甲烷化改型）
pois.detail: Ø5.0 m 单芯级，贮箱环缝分段，白底 + 国旗色环带 + 竖排箭名涂装。地球构型烧液氧/煤油，但煤油在火星无法就地生产——本地部署构型按 ISRU 甲烷化改型标注（YF-100M 示意，液氧/液态甲烷），推进剂全部由萨巴蒂尔工艺就地合成。

specs.运力: LEO ~14 t（回收）/ ~18 t（不回收，推定）

sim: L2 升轨闭合（scripts/sim_ascent_veh_rocket_02.py）：火星 RTLS 构型 GLOW 仅 298 t（地球满箱 740 t）——ISRU 按需加注；高抛分离（1000 m/s、γ=26°、38 km）→ 上面级续燃入 200 km 低火轨，总 Δv 4.13 km/s（引力损失 461、阻力 8 m/s），LMO 运力 18~24 t
L2 一子级返场（sim_boostback）：boostback 26.5 t + 着陆 15.0 t = 41.6 t / 储备 48 t（裕度 13%）；ZEM/ZEV 制导杀掉 204 m/s 横向漂移，挂缆 4.1 m/s、落点误差 0.19 m；再入热流指标 ½ρv³ 峰值仅 367 kW/m² → 无需再入燃烧
L2 蒙特卡洛（sim_dispersion，N=500）：推力/质量/大气/±12 m/s 风/导航偏差全散布下落点 σ=0.55 m、CEP 0.41 m，网捕窗口捕获概率 100%——散布主导项是导航偏差，火星稀薄大气反而是精确回收的盟友
L1.5 ISRU 战役（sim_isru）：每发 215.3 t 推进剂（CH4 47.8 + LOX 167.5）= 净耗水 107.7 t（res-rodwell 冰井）+ 1174 MWh；200 kWe 电站即可每发射窗口（780 sol）打 3.3 发，对照 veh-rocket-01 满箱 1200 t 需 1.6 MWe——中型复用箭+ISRU 是火星发射的能量甜点
SSTO 旁证（L1 齐氏）：一子级装填 180 t 单独带 18 t 载荷 Δv=4435 m/s ≥ 升轨需求 4.13 km/s → 火星单级入轨成立，但牺牲回收储备，两级+RTLS 更优
pois.detail_en: A single 5.0 m core stage with segmented tank weld lands, white livery with flag-color band and vertical rocket name. The Earth build burns LOX/kerosene, but kerosene cannot be made on Mars - the locally deployed build is marked as the ISRU methane variant (YF-100M notional, LOX/liquid methane), all propellant synthesized on site via the Sabatier process.
sim_en: L2 ascent closure (scripts/sim_ascent_veh_rocket_02.py): the Mars RTLS build lifts off at only 298 t GLOW (vs 740 t full on Earth) - ISRU fills to need; lofted staging (1000 m/s, gamma 26 deg, 38 km) -> upper stage burns into a 200 km low Mars orbit, total dv 4.13 km/s (gravity loss 461, drag 8 m/s), LMO payload 18-24 t

L2 booster return (sim_boostback): boostback 26.5 t + landing 15.0 t = 41.6 t against a 48 t reserve (13% margin); ZEM/ZEV guidance kills 204 m/s of crossrange drift, cable catch at 4.1 m/s with 0.19 m dispersion; entry heating metric (rho v3/2) peaks at just 367 kW/m2 -> no entry burn needed

L2 Monte Carlo (sim_dispersion, N=500): with thrust/mass/atmosphere/±12 m/s wind/navigation scatter all in, landing sigma = 0.55 m, CEP 0.41 m, 100% capture probability in the net window - navigation bias dominates, and the thin Martian air is actually an ally of precision recovery

L1.5 ISRU campaign (sim_isru): each launch takes 215.3 t of propellant (CH4 47.8 + LOX 167.5) = 107.7 t net water (res-rodwell ice well) + 1174 MWh; a 200 kWe plant supports 3.3 launches per window (780 sol), versus 1.6 MWe to fill veh-rocket-01's 1200 t - a mid-size reusable rocket plus ISRU is the energy sweet spot of Mars launch

SSTO side-check (L1 Tsiolkovsky): the first stage alone with 180 t load and 18 t payload gives dv = 4435 m/s >= the 4.13 km/s ascent requirement -> Mars SSTO closes, but it spends the recovery reserve; two stages + RTLS wins
